hazards.control: Flare and tanks sited downwind; hot work controls; static bonding on tanks and lines.

name: Flowback tanks
function: The tanks that receive oil and water from the separator for gauging and haul-off or transfer to the facility.

tabs.overview: Gauged by hand or level sensor to measure liquid volumes; oil and water in separate tanks; vapor handled by a vent or a vapor recovery unit.
tabs.engineering: Atmospheric or low-pressure tanks; bonding and grounding; secondary containment.
tabs.connections: Separator liquid outlets; truck load-out; vent or VRU.
tabs.safety: Flammable vapor at hatches; confined space; grounding.
tabs.evidence: Public flowback and well testing overview (S25), field practice (S9).
